pages.title: Area Attacks
pages.text: A charged impact attacks eligible creatures throughout its area and applies the matching lingering burn. Leaving ground fire does not immediately end that burn.$(br2)Charged blasts can instantly destroy ordinary terrain and liquids in their radius. Protected locations, containers, and unbreakable blocks retain their protection.

pages.title: Block Breaking Settings
pages.text: Open cultivation settings and choose its first entry, Block Breaking. Separate options govern spells, weapons, external Qi, Flame Vessels, and other terrain effects.$(br2)Disabling vessel terrain damage still permits the fireball to damage creatures. Turning off block breaking does not turn off combat.
